scheme_name: Incentive Scheme for MSMEs in Powerloom Sector: Work Force Welfare Assistance
other_conditions: Enterprises must be micro, small or medium enterprises (MSMEs) in the powerloom sector
Production must have started between 01‑01‑2022 and 31‑12‑2024
A four‑party agreement with the Directorate of Textiles, a financial institution and Tantuja must be executed
Units can be private, cooperative, joint‑sector, or owned/managed by the State Government and Industrial SHGs
The project must be supported by a detailed feasibility report
The project must be approved and sanctioned by a Central Financial Institution, Commercial Bank or State Financial Institution
At least 50 % of the employees must be recruited from persons registered with the State Employment Bank
benefits_summary: Provides 100 % reimbursement of ESI and EPF contributions in the first year and 75 % thereafter, for a duration of 5–9 years depending on the zone.
